news.title: Xavi Hernandez named first foreign coach of the Netherlands since 1978
news.lede: Former Barcelona player and Spanish international Xavi Hernandez has been appointed manager of the Netherlands, succeeding Ronald Koeman, who resigned after the World Cup. PARIS – Barcelona great Xavi Hernandez hailed a “special connection” to Dutch football after he was named as the new coach of the Netherlands national team on Aug 12, becoming their first foreign boss in 48 years. The former midfielder, who played a key role in Spain’s 2010 World Cup-winning campaign, has not held a head coaching job since leaving the Camp Nou in 2024. Xavi, who replaces Ronald Koeman, has signed a four-year deal, which means he will lead the Oranje’s Euro 2028 and 2030 World Cup campaigns.

news.title: Netherlands appoint Spain great Xavi Hernandez as first foreign-born coach since 1978
news.lede: Spain great Xavi Hernandez was named as the Netherlands coach till the 2030 FIFA World Cup, incidentally becoming the first foreign-born leader of the national team in nearly 50 years. . The 46-year-old was a member of the Spain team that beat the Dutch in the World Cup final in 2010, marking their third defeat in the title match. .
